description: This file defines the Coocook::Schema package, which is a Perl module implementing a database schema using DBIx::Class. It includes methods for database connection customization, statistics gathering, and database-specific operations such as setting constraints and pragma configurations.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema
classes.description: A Perl class representing the database schema for the Coocook application, extending DBIx::Class::Schema::Config with custom methods for connection handling, statistics, and database-specific operations.

methods.name: connection
methods.description: Overrides the default connection method to set default connection parameters, especially enabling foreign key constraints in SQLite.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of records across specified resultsets or all sources if none specified.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Provides aggregated statistics about dishes, recipes, projects, users, and organizations in the database.

methods.name: pgsql_set_constraints_deferred
methods.description: Sets all constraints to deferred in PostgreSQL databases.

methods.name: fk_checks_off_do
methods.description: Temporarily disables foreign key checks in SQLite, runs a provided code reference, then restores the original foreign key setting.

methods.name: enable_fk_checks
methods.description: Enables foreign key checks in SQLite.

methods.name: disable_fk_checks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in SQLite.

methods.name: sqlite_pragma
methods.description: Gets or sets a SQLite PRAGMA value.
